scenes.dialogue: If a civil suit settles out of court after the witnesses have already testified, can the court fee still be refunded, or is every rupee of it gone?
The Supreme Court has allowed a full refund even for private settlements. Yet one trial court gave only half, and another gave nothing. So who got it right?
Hi, I'm Ravishankar from LawWorld. On thirtieth October, twenty twenty six, Honourable Justice P B Balaji of the Madras High Court ruled.
scenes.shown: Hi, I'm Ravishankar from LawWorld. On 30 October 2026, Honourable Justice P.B. Balaji of the Madras High Court ruled.

scenes.dialogue: In one suit for specific performance, they settled after the plaintiff's witness filed a proof affidavit. The trial court refunded only half the fee, less five per cent.
scenes.shown: In one suit for specific performance, they settled after the plaintiff's witness filed a proof affidavit. The trial court refunded only half the fee, less 5%.

scenes.dialogue: In the other suit, both sides had examined witnesses, and even a court witness, when they compromised. There, the trial court refused any refund at all.
The plaintiffs relied on the Supreme Court's ruling in M C Subramaniam: even a private settlement earns a full refund under Section Sixty Nine A.
scenes.shown: The plaintiffs relied on the Supreme Court's ruling in M.C. Subramaniam: even a private settlement earns a full refund under Section 69-A.

scenes.dialogue: The Advocate General said that ruling never considered Afcons, on the stage of settlement; the amicus added it never dealt with Section Sixty Nine.
scenes.shown: The Advocate General said that ruling never considered Afcons, on the stage of settlement; the amicus added it never dealt with Section 69.

scenes.dialogue: Before I tell you what the High Court decided, a quick request: follow LawWorld, and try India's all in one A I platform for advocates at lawworld dot A I.
scenes.shown: Before I tell you what the High Court decided, a quick request: follow LawWorld, and try India's all-in-one AI platform for advocates at lawworld.ai.

scenes.dialogue: Finally, what did the High Court decide? Under Section Sixty Nine, a refund is allowed only if the suit settles before any evidence is recorded.
scenes.shown: Finally, what did the High Court decide? Under Section 69, a refund is allowed only if the suit settles before any evidence is recorded.

scenes.dialogue: Following Afcons, the earlier Supreme Court ruling, it held: no refund once evidence is recorded. Both petitions failed, but the unchallenged half refund stays.
